settingsToApply.name: Deployment method
settingsToApply.value: Git integration (the STS default, D-P3-3) with framework preset None and the output directory below, or Direct Upload of this bundle. Direct Upload cannot be switched to Git integration later (CF-20): decide per client.

settingsToApply.name: Framework preset / build command
settingsToApply.value: None. Leave the build command blank (CF-22); the same page also says to use `exit 0` when no preset is used (CF-23): use whichever the dashboard accepts. No install step, no environment variables.

settingsToApply.name: Custom domain
settingsToApply.value: None: the demonstration is never published on a client domain. Do not enable zone features that rewrite HTML (email address obfuscation, Rocket Loader, automatic minification, injected analytics): the CSP allows only the hashed inline script (HR-08).

settingsToApply.name: Preview deployments
settingsToApply.value: Public by default (CF-19). None is authorised (D-P3-5). If one is ever authorised, protect it with Cloudflare Access and keep X-Robots-Tag: noindex.

unverifiedLive: the status of the redirect from /products.html to /products (308 is assumed)
what /index, /404 and /404.html do (modelled: not found, answered with the 404 page)
that the 404.html response has status 404 (the documentation says only that the page is displayed when a file is not found)
whether the _headers rules apply to the 404.html response and to the home-page fallback

whether a header set in _headers replaces the platform's default of the same name (modelled, as the documentation says _headers "override what Cloudflare ordinarily sends") or is joined with it; Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is a platform default the bundle does not remove
the content types served for .xml, .txt, .webm, .mp4 and .woff2
Range support for the hero video: the documentation says 200 is returned, which Safari cannot seek (HR-12)
that the deployed bytes equal the staged bytes (checklist C-07)
that request paths are matched case-sensitively, so /Products is not answered from products.html (modelled; the pages read do not say, and nothing was observed live)
compression and caching at the edge
HSTS: that the header is sent as written and not changed by a zone setting

capabilities.trailingSlash: platform (not established for a page file such as /products/)
capabilities.previewNoindex: automatic (platform adds X-Robots-Tag: noindex over preview URLs)
capabilities.ranges: documented to answer Range requests with 200, not 206 (CF-12)

noCredential: This bundle holds no hosting credential, account, project or team identifier and cannot deploy anything.
